text: The AI Office, after consulting the Board, may conduct evaluations of the general-purpose AI model concerned: (a) to assess compliance of the provider with obligations under this Regulation, where the information gathered pursuant to Article 91 is insufficient; or (b) to investigate systemic risks at Union level of general-purpose AI models with systemic risk, in particular following a qualified alert from the scientific panel in accordance with Article 90(1), point (a).

The Commission may decide to appoint independent experts to carry out evaluations on its behalf, including from the scientific panel established pursuant to Article 68. Independent experts appointed for this task shall meet the criteria outlined in Article 68(2).
For the purposes of paragraph 1, the Commission may request access to the general-purpose AI model concerned through APIs or further appropriate technical means and tools, including source code.

The request for access shall state the legal basis, the purpose and reasons of the request and set the period within which the access is to be provided, and the fines provided for in Article 101 for failure to provide access.

The providers of the general-purpose AI model concerned or its representative shall supply the information requested. In the case of legal persons, companies or firms, or where the provider has no legal personality, the persons authorised to represent them by law or by their statutes, shall provide the access requested on behalf of the provider of the general-purpose AI model concerned.
text_ko: 관련 범용 인공지능모델의 제공자 또는 그 대리인은 요청받은 정보를 제공하여야 한다. 법인·회사인 경우 또는 제공자가 법인격이 없는 경우, 법률 또는 정관에 따라 그들을 대표할 권한을 가진 자가 관련 범용 인공지능모델 제공자를 대신하여 요청받은 접근을 제공하여야 한다.

text: The Commission shall adopt implementing acts setting out the detailed arrangements and the conditions for the evaluations, including the detailed arrangements for involving independent experts, and the procedure for the selection thereof. Those implementing acts shall be adopted in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 98(2).

Prior to requesting access to the general-purpose AI model concerned, the AI Office may initiate a structured dialogue with the provider of the general-purpose AI model to gather more information on the internal testing of the model, internal safeguards for preventing systemic risks, and other internal procedures and measures the provider has taken to mitigate such risks.

title: Power to request measures

text: Where necessary and appropriate, the Commission may request providers to: (a) take appropriate measures to comply with the obligations set out in Articles 53 and 54; (b) implement mitigation measures, where the evaluation carried out in accordance with Article 92 has given rise to serious and substantiated concern of a systemic risk at Union level; (c) restrict the making available on the market, withdraw or recall the model.
Before a measure is requested, the AI Office may initiate a structured dialogue with the provider of the general-purpose AI model.

If, during the structured dialogue referred to in paragraph 2, the provider of the general-purpose AI model with systemic risk offers commitments to implement mitigation measures to address a systemic risk at Union level, the Commission may, by decision, make those commitments binding and declare that there are no further grounds for action.

title: Procedural rights of economic operators of the general-purpose AI model
text: Article 18 of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 shall apply mutatis mutandis to the providers of the general-purpose AI model, without prejudice to more specific procedural rights provided for in this Regulation.

title: Codes of conduct for voluntary application of specific requirements

text: The AI Office and the Member States shall encourage and facilitate the drawing up of codes of conduct, including related governance mechanisms, intended to foster the voluntary application to AI systems, other than high-risk AI systems, of some or all of the requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2 taking into account the available technical solutions and industry best practices allowing for the application of such requirements.

The AI Office and the Member States shall facilitate the drawing up of codes of conduct concerning the voluntary application, including by deployers, of specific requirements to all AI systems, on the basis of clear objectives and key performance indicators to measure the achievement of those objectives, including elements such as, but not limited to: (a) applicable elements provided for in Union ethical guidelines for trustworthy AI; (b) assessing and minimising the impact of AI systems on environmental sustainability, including as regards energy-efficient programming and techniques for the efficient design, training and use of AI; (c) promoting AI literacy, in particular that of persons dealing with the development, operation and use of AI; (d) facilitating an inclusive and diverse design of AI systems, including through the establishment of inclusive and diverse development teams and the promotion of stakeholders’ participation in that process; (e) assessing and preventing the negative impact of AI systems on vulnerable persons or groups of vulnerable persons, including as regards accessibility for persons with a disability, as well as on gender equality.

Codes of conduct may be drawn up by individual providers or deployers of AI systems or by organisations representing them or by both, including with the involvement of any interested stakeholders and their representative organisations, including civil society organisations and academia. Codes of conduct may cover one or more AI systems taking into account the similarity of the intended purpose of the relevant systems.
The AI Office and the Member States shall take into account the specific interests and needs of SMEs, including start-ups, when encouraging and facilitating the drawing up of codes of conduct.

title: Guidelines from the Commission on the implementation of this Regulation

text: The Commission shall develop guidelines on the practical implementation of this Regulation, and in particular on: (a) the application of the requirements and obligations referred to in Articles 8 to 15 and in Article 25; (b) the prohibited practices referred to in Article 5; (c) the practical implementation of the provisions related to substantial modification; (d) the practical implementation of transparency obligations laid down in Article 50; (e) detailed information on the relationship of this Regulation with the Union harmonisation legislation listed in Annex I, as well as with other relevant Union law, including as regards consistency in their enforcement; (f) the application of the definition of an AI system as set out in Article 3, point (1). When issuing such guidelines, the Commission shall pay particular attention to the needs of SMEs including start-ups, of local public authorities and of the sectors most likely to be affected by this Regulation. The guidelines referred to in the first subparagraph of this paragraph shall take due account of the generally acknowledged state of the art on AI, as well as of relevant harmonised standards and common specifications that are referred to in Articles 40 and 41, or of those harmonised standards or technical specifications that are set out pursuant to Union harmonisation law.
At the request of the Member States or the AI Office, or on its own initiative, the Commission shall update guidelines previously adopted when deemed necessary.

title: Exercise of the delegation

text: The power to adopt delegated acts is conferred on the Commission subject to the conditions laid down in this Article.

The power to adopt delegated acts referred to in Article 6(6) and (7), Article 7(1) and (3), Article 11(3), Article 43(5) and (6), Article 47(5), Article 51(3), Article 52(4) and Article 53(5) and (6) shall be conferred on the Commission for a period of five years from 1 August 2024. The Commission shall draw up a report in respect of the delegation of power not later than nine months before the end of the five-year period. The delegation of power shall be tacitly extended for periods of an identical duration, unless the European Parliament or the Council opposes such extension not later than three months before the end of each period.

The delegation of power referred to in Article 6(6) and (7), Article 7(1) and (3), Article 11(3), Article 43(5) and (6), Article 47(5), Article 51(3), Article 52(4) and Article 53(5) and (6) may be revoked at any time by the European Parliament or by the Council. A decision of revocation shall put an end to the delegation of power specified in that decision. It shall take effect the day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union or at a later date specified therein. It shall not affect the validity of any delegated acts already in force.

Before adopting a delegated act, the Commission shall consult experts designated by each Member State in accordance with the principles laid down in the Interinstitutional Agreement of 13 April 2016 on Better Law-Making.
As soon as it adopts a delegated act, the Commission shall notify it simultaneously to the European Parliament and to the Council.

Any delegated act adopted pursuant to Article 6(6) or (7), Article 7(1) or (3), Article 11(3), Article 43(5) or (6), Article 47(5), Article 51(3), Article 52(4) or Article 53(5) or (6) shall enter into force only if no objection has been expressed by either the European Parliament or the Council within a period of three months of notification of that act to the European Parliament and the Council or if, before the expiry of that period, the European Parliament and the Council have both informed the Commission that they will not object. That period shall be extended by three months at the initiative of the European Parliament or of the Council.

title: Committee procedure

text: The Commission shall be assisted by a committee. That committee shall be a committee within the meaning of Regulation (EU) No 182/2011.
Where reference is made to this paragraph, Article 5 of Regulation (EU) No 182/2011 shall apply.
text_ko: 이 항이 언급되는 경우, 규정(EU) No 182/2011 제5조가 적용된다.

title: Penalties

text: In accordance with the terms and conditions laid down in this Regulation, Member States shall lay down the rules on penalties and other enforcement measures, which may also include warnings and non-monetary measures, applicable to infringements of this Regulation by operators, and shall take all measures necessary to ensure that they are properly and effectively implemented, thereby taking into account the guidelines issued by the Commission pursuant to Article 96. The penalties provided for shall be effective, proportionate and dissuasive. They shall take into account the interests of SMEs, including start-ups, and their economic viability.
text_ko: 이 규정에서 정하는 조건에 따라, 회원국은 경고 및 비금전적 조치를 포함할 수 있는, 운영자에 의한 이 규정 위반에 적용되는 벌칙 및 그 밖의 집행조치에 관한 규칙을 정하여야 하며, 그것이 적절하고 효과적으로 이행되도록 보장하기 위하여 필요한 모든 조치를 취하여야 하고, 이때 제96조에 따라 위원회가 발행하는 지침을 고려하여야 한다. 정해지는 벌칙은 효과적이고 비례적이며 억지력이 있어야 한다. 벌칙은 신생기업을 포함한 중소기업의 이익과 그 경제적 존립가능성을 고려하여야 한다.

text: The Member States shall, without delay and at the latest by the date of entry into application, notify the Commission of the rules on penalties and of other enforcement measures referred to in paragraph 1, and shall notify it, without delay, of any subsequent amendment to them.
text_ko: 회원국은 지체 없이, 늦어도 적용개시일까지, 제1항에서 정하는 벌칙 및 그 밖의 집행조치에 관한 규칙을 위원회에 통지하여야 하며, 그 후속 개정이 있을 경우에도 지체 없이 통지하여야 한다.

text: Non-compliance with the prohibition of the AI practices referred to in Article 5 shall be subject to administrative fines of up to EUR 35 000 000 or, if the offender is an undertaking, up to 7 % of its total worldwide annual turnover for the preceding financial year, whichever is higher.
text_ko: 제5조에서 정하는 AI 관행 금지의 미준수는 최대 3,500만 유로 또는, 위반자가 사업체인 경우 직전 회계연도 전세계 연간 총매출액의 7%(둘 중 더 높은 금액) 이하의 과징금의 대상이 된다.

text: Non-compliance with any of the following provisions related to operators or notified bodies, other than those laid down in Articles 5, shall be subject to administrative fines of up to EUR 15 000 000 or, if the offender is an undertaking, up to 3 % of its total worldwide annual turnover for the preceding financial year, whichever is higher: (a) obligations of providers pursuant to Article 16; (b) obligations of authorised representatives pursuant to Article 22; (c) obligations of importers pursuant to Article 23; (d) obligations of distributors pursuant to Article 24; (e) obligations of deployers pursuant to Article 26; (f) requirements and obligations of notified bodies pursuant to Article 31, Article 33(1), (3) and (4) or Article 34; (g) transparency obligations for providers and deployers pursuant to Article 50.
text_ko: 제5조에서 정하는 것 이외의, 운영자 또는 인증기관과 관련된 다음 규정 중 어느 하나의 미준수는 최대 1,500만 유로 또는, 위반자가 사업체인 경우 직전 회계연도 전세계 연간 총매출액의 3%(둘 중 더 높은 금액) 이하의 과징금의 대상이 된다. (a) 제16조에 따른 제공자의 의무; (b) 제22조에 따른 수권대리인의 의무; (c) 제23조에 따른 수입업자의 의무; (d) 제24조에 따른 유통업자의 의무; (e) 제26조에 따른 배포자의 의무; (f) 제31조, 제33조(1)(3)(4) 또는 제34조에 따른 인증기관의 요건 및 의무; (g) 제50조에 따른 제공자 및 배포자의 투명성 의무.

text: The supply of incorrect, incomplete or misleading information to notified bodies or national competent authorities in reply to a request shall be subject to administrative fines of up to EUR 7 500 000 or, if the offender is an undertaking, up to 1 % of its total worldwide annual turnover for the preceding financial year, whichever is higher.
text_ko: 요청에 대한 응답으로 인증기관 또는 국가관할당국에 부정확하거나 불완전하거나 오해를 유발하는 정보를 제공하는 행위는 최대 750만 유로 또는, 위반자가 사업체인 경우 직전 회계연도 전세계 연간 총매출액의 1%(둘 중 더 높은 금액) 이하의 과징금의 대상이 된다.

text: In the case of SMEs, including start-ups, each fine referred to in this Article shall be up to the percentages or amount referred to in paragraphs 3, 4 and 5, whichever thereof is lower.
text_ko: 신생기업을 포함한 중소기업의 경우, 이 조에서 정하는 각 과징금은 제3항, 제4항 및 제5항에서 정하는 비율 또는 금액 중 더 낮은 쪽을 상한으로 한다.

text: When deciding whether to impose an administrative fine and when deciding on the amount of the administrative fine in each individual case, all relevant circumstances of the specific situation shall be taken into account and, as appropriate, regard shall be given to the following: (a) the nature, gravity and duration of the infringement and of its consequences, taking into account the purpose of the AI system, as well as, where appropriate, the number of affected persons and the level of damage suffered by them; (b) whether administrative fines have already been applied by other market surveillance authorities to the same operator for the same infringement; (c) whether administrative fines have already been applied by other authorities to the same operator for infringements of other Union or national law, when such infringements result from the same activity or omission constituting a relevant infringement of this Regulation; (d) the size, the annual turnover and market share of the operator committing the infringement; (e) any other aggravating or mitigating factor applicable to the circumstances of the case, such as financial benefits gained, or losses avoided, directly or indirectly, from the infringement; (f) the degree of cooperation with the national competent authorities, in order to remedy the infringement and mitigate the possible adverse effects of the infringement; (g) the degree of responsibility of the operator taking into account the technical and organisational measures implemented by it; (h) the manner in which the infringement became known to the national competent authorities, in particular whether, and if so to what extent, the operator notified the infringement; (i) the intentional or negligent character of the infringement; (j) any action taken by the operator to mitigate the harm suffered by the affected persons.
text_ko: 행정과징금 부과 여부 및 각 개별 사안에서 그 금액을 결정할 때에는, 구체적 상황의 모든 관련 사정을 고려하여야 하며, 적절한 경우 다음 사항을 고려하여야 한다. (a) 위반 및 그 결과의 성격·중대성·기간(인공지능시스템의 목적, 해당하는 경우 영향을 받은 사람의 수 및 그들이 입은 피해의 정도를 고려); (b) 동일한 위반에 대하여 다른 시장감시당국이 동일한 운영자에게 이미 행정과징금을 부과하였는지 여부; (c) 그러한 위반이 이 규정의 관련 위반을 구성하는 동일한 행위 또는 부작위에서 발생하는 경우, 다른 연합법 또는 국내법 위반에 대하여 다른 당국이 동일한 운영자에게 이미 행정과징금을 부과하였는지 여부; (d) 위반을 저지른 운영자의 규모, 연간매출액 및 시장점유율; (e) 위반으로부터 직접 또는 간접으로 얻은 재정적 이익이나 회피한 손실 등, 사건의 상황에 적용 가능한 그 밖의 가중 또는 경감 요소; (f) 위반을 시정하고 위반의 발생 가능한 부정적 영향을 완화하기 위한 국가관할당국과의 협력 정도; (g) 운영자가 시행한 기술적·조직적 조치를 고려한 운영자의 책임 정도; (h) 위반이 국가관할당국에 알려지게 된 방식, 특히 운영자가 그 위반을 통지하였는지 여부 및 통지하였다면 그 정도; (i) 위반의 고의성 또는 과실 여부; (j) 영향을 받은 사람이 입은 피해를 완화하기 위하여 운영자가 취한 조치.

text: Each Member State shall lay down rules on to what extent administrative fines may be imposed on public authorities and bodies established in that Member State.
text_ko: 각 회원국은 그 회원국에 설립된 공공당국 및 기관에 대하여 행정과징금을 어느 범위까지 부과할 수 있는지에 관한 규칙을 정하여야 한다.

text: Depending on the legal system of the Member States, the rules on administrative fines may be applied in such a manner that the fines are imposed by competent national courts or by other bodies, as applicable in those Member States. The application of such rules in those Member States shall have an equivalent effect.
text_ko: 회원국의 법체계에 따라, 행정과징금에 관한 규칙은 그 회원국에서 적용 가능한 바에 따라 관할 국내법원 또는 그 밖의 기관이 과징금을 부과하는 방식으로 적용될 수 있다. 그러한 회원국에서 그러한 규칙의 적용은 동등한 효과를 가져야 한다.

text: The exercise of powers under this Article shall be subject to appropriate procedural safeguards in accordance with Union and national law, including effective judicial remedies and due process.
text_ko: 이 조에 따른 권한 행사는, 효과적인 사법구제 및 적법절차를 포함하여 연합법 및 국내법에 따른 적절한 절차적 보호장치의 적용을 받는다.

text: Member States shall, on an annual basis, report to the Commission about the administrative fines they have issued during that year, in accordance with this Article, and about any related litigation or judicial proceedings.
text_ko: 회원국은 매년, 이 조에 따라 그 해에 발부한 행정과징금 및 관련된 소송이나 사법절차에 관하여 위원회에 보고하여야 한다.

title: Administrative fines on Union institutions, bodies, offices and agencies

text: The European Data Protection Supervisor may impose administrative fines on Union institutions, bodies, offices and agencies falling within the scope of this Regulation. When deciding whether to impose an administrative fine and when deciding on the amount of the administrative fine in each individual case, all relevant circumstances of the specific situation shall be taken into account and due regard shall be given to the following: (a) the nature, gravity and duration of the infringement and of its consequences, taking into account the purpose of the AI system concerned, as well as, where appropriate, the number of affected persons and the level of damage suffered by them; (b) the degree of responsibility of the Union institution, body, office or agency, taking into account technical and organisational measures implemented by them; (c) any action taken by the Union institution, body, office or agency to mitigate the damage suffered by affected persons; (d) the degree of cooperation with the European Data Protection Supervisor in order to remedy the infringement and mitigate the possible adverse effects of the infringement, including compliance with any of the measures previously ordered by the European Data Protection Supervisor against the Union institution, body, office or agency concerned with regard to the same subject matter; (e) any similar previous infringements by the Union institution, body, office or agency; (f) the manner in which the infringement became known to the European Data Protection Supervisor, in particular whether, and if so to what extent, the Union institution, body, office or agency notified the infringement; (g) the annual budget of the Union institution, body, office or agency.
Non-compliance with the prohibition of the AI practices referred to in Article 5 shall be subject to administrative fines of up to EUR 1 500 000.
The non-compliance of the AI system with any requirements or obligations under this Regulation, other than those laid down in Article 5, shall be subject to administrative fines of up to EUR 750 000.

Before taking decisions pursuant to this Article, the European Data Protection Supervisor shall give the Union institution, body, office or agency which is the subject of the proceedings conducted by the European Data Protection Supervisor the opportunity of being heard on the matter regarding the possible infringement. The European Data Protection Supervisor shall base his or her decisions only on elements and circumstances on which the parties concerned have been able to comment. Complainants, if any, shall be associated closely with the proceedings.

The rights of defence of the parties concerned shall be fully respected in the proceedings. They shall be entitled to have access to the European Data Protection Supervisor’s file, subject to the legitimate interest of individuals or undertakings in the protection of their personal data or business secrets.

Funds collected by imposition of fines in this Article shall contribute to the general budget of the Union. The fines shall not affect the effective operation of the Union institution, body, office or agency fined.

The European Data Protection Supervisor shall, on an annual basis, notify the Commission of the administrative fines it has imposed pursuant to this Article and of any litigation or judicial proceedings it has initiated.

title: Fines for providers of general-purpose AI models

text: The Commission may impose on providers of general-purpose AI models fines not exceeding 3 % of their annual total worldwide turnover in the preceding financial year or EUR 15 000 000, whichever is higher., when the Commission finds that the provider intentionally or negligently: (a) infringed the relevant provisions of this Regulation; (b) failed to comply with a request for a document or for information pursuant to Article 91, or supplied incorrect, incomplete or misleading information; (c) failed to comply with a measure requested under Article 93; (d) failed to make available to the Commission access to the general-purpose AI model or general-purpose AI model with systemic risk with a view to conducting an evaluation pursuant to Article 92. In fixing the amount of the fine or periodic penalty payment, regard shall be had to the nature, gravity and duration of the infringement, taking due account of the principles of proportionality and appropriateness. The Commission shall also into account commitments made in accordance with Article 93(3) or made in relevant codes of practice in accordance with Article 56.
Before adopting the decision pursuant to paragraph 1, the Commission shall communicate its preliminary findings to the provider of the general-purpose AI model and give it an opportunity to be heard.
Fines imposed in accordance with this Article shall be effective, proportionate and dissuasive.
Information on fines imposed under this Article shall also be communicated to the Board as appropriate.

The Court of Justice of the European Union shall have unlimited jurisdiction to review decisions of the Commission fixing a fine under this Article. It may cancel, reduce or increase the fine imposed.

The Commission shall adopt implementing acts containing detailed arrangements and procedural safeguards for proceedings in view of the possible adoption of decisions pursuant to paragraph 1 of this Article. Those implementing acts shall be adopted in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 98(2).

title: AI systems already placed on the market or put into service and general-purpose AI models already placed on the marked
title_ko: 이미 시장에 출시되거나 서비스가 개시된 인공지능시스템 및 이미 시장에 출시된 범용 인공지능모델

text: Without prejudice to the application of Article 5 as referred to in Article 113(3), point (a), AI systems which are components of the large-scale IT systems established by the legal acts listed in Annex X that have been placed on the market or put into service before 2 August 2027 shall be brought into compliance with this Regulation by 31 December 2030. The requirements laid down in this Regulation shall be taken into account in the evaluation of each large-scale IT system established by the legal acts listed in Annex X to be undertaken as provided for in those legal acts and where those legal acts are replaced or amended.
text_ko: 제113조제3항 (a)호에서 정하는 제5조의 적용을 저해하지 아니하고, 부속서 X에 열거된 법령에 따라 설치된 대규모 정보시스템의 구성요소인 인공지능시스템으로서 2027년 8월 2일 이전에 시장에 출시되거나 서비스가 개시된 것은 2030년 12월 31일까지 이 규정에 적합하게 되어야 한다. 이 규정에서 정하는 요건은 부속서 X에 열거된 법령에 따라 설치된 각 대규모 정보시스템에 대하여 그 법령이 정하는 바에 따라 실시되는 평가에서, 그리고 그 법령이 대체되거나 개정되는 경우에 고려되어야 한다.

text: Without prejudice to the application of Article 5 as referred to in Article 113(3), point (a), this Regulation shall apply to operators of high-risk AI systems, other than the systems referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article, that have been placed on the market or put into service before 2 August 2026, only if, as from that date, those systems are subject to significant changes in their designs. In any case, the providers and deployers of high-risk AI systems intended to be used by public authorities shall take the necessary steps to comply with the requirements and obligations of this Regulation by 2 August 2030.
text_ko: 제113조제3항 (a)호에서 정하는 제5조의 적용을 저해하지 아니하고, 이 규정은 이 조 제1항에서 정하는 시스템 외의 고위험 인공지능시스템으로서 2026년 8월 2일 이전에 시장에 출시되거나 서비스가 개시된 것의 운영자에 대하여는, 그 날부터 그러한 시스템의 설계에 중대한 변경이 있는 경우에만 적용된다. 어떠한 경우에도 공공당국이 사용하도록 의도된 고위험 인공지능시스템의 제공자와 배포자는 2030년 8월 2일까지 이 규정의 요건과 의무를 준수하기 위하여 필요한 조치를 취하여야 한다.

text: Providers of general-purpose AI models that have been placed on the market before 2 August 2025 shall take the necessary steps in order to comply with the obligations laid down in this Regulation by 2 August 2027.
text_ko: 2025년 8월 2일 이전에 시장에 출시된 범용 인공지능모델의 제공자는 2027년 8월 2일까지 이 규정에서 정하는 의무를 준수하기 위하여 필요한 조치를 취하여야 한다.

title: Evaluation and review

text: The Commission shall assess the need for amendment of the list set out in Annex III and of the list of prohibited AI practices laid down in Article 5, once a year following the entry into force of this Regulation, and until the end of the period of the delegation of power laid down in Article 97. The Commission shall submit the findings of that assessment to the European Parliament and the Council.

By 2 August 2028 and every four years thereafter, the Commission shall evaluate and report to the European Parliament and to the Council on the following: (a) the need for amendments extending existing area headings or adding new area headings in Annex III; (b) amendments to the list of AI systems requiring additional transparency measures in Article 50; (c) amendments enhancing the effectiveness of the supervision and governance system.

By 2 August 2029 and every four years thereafter, the Commission shall submit a report on the evaluation and review of this Regulation to the European Parliament and to the Council. The report shall include an assessment with regard to the structure of enforcement and the possible need for a Union agency to resolve any identified shortcomings. On the basis of the findings, that report shall, where appropriate, be accompanied by a proposal for amendment of this Regulation. The reports shall be made public.

The reports referred to in paragraph 2 shall pay specific attention to the following: (a) the status of the financial, technical and human resources of the national competent authorities in order to effectively perform the tasks assigned to them under this Regulation; (b) the state of penalties, in particular administrative fines as referred to in Article 99(1), applied by Member States for infringements of this Regulation; (c) adopted harmonised standards and common specifications developed to support this Regulation; (d) the number of undertakings that enter the market after the entry into application of this Regulation, and how many of them are SMEs.

By 2 August 2028, the Commission shall evaluate the functioning of the AI Office, whether the AI Office has been given sufficient powers and competences to fulfil its tasks, and whether it would be relevant and needed for the proper implementation and enforcement of this Regulation to upgrade the AI Office and its enforcement competences and to increase its resources. The Commission shall submit a report on its evaluation to the European Parliament and to the Council.

By 2 August 2028 and every four years thereafter, the Commission shall submit a report on the review of the progress on the development of standardisation deliverables on the energy-efficient development of general-purpose AI models, and asses the need for further measures or actions, including binding measures or actions. The report shall be submitted to the European Parliament and to the Council, and it shall be made public.

By 2 August 2028 and every three years thereafter, the Commission shall evaluate the impact and effectiveness of voluntary codes of conduct to foster the application of the requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2 for AI systems other than high-risk AI systems and possibly other additional requirements for AI systems other than high-risk AI systems, including as regards environmental sustainability.
For the purposes of paragraphs 1 to 7, the Board, the Member States and national competent authorities shall provide the Commission with information upon its request and without undue delay.

In carrying out the evaluations and reviews referred to in paragraphs 1 to 7, the Commission shall take into account the positions and findings of the Board, of the European Parliament, of the Council, and of other relevant bodies or sources.

The Commission shall, if necessary, submit appropriate proposals to amend this Regulation, in particular taking into account developments in technology, the effect of AI systems on health and safety, and on fundamental rights, and in light of the state of progress in the information society.

To guide the evaluations and reviews referred to in paragraphs 1 to 7 of this Article, the AI Office shall undertake to develop an objective and participative methodology for the evaluation of risk levels based on the criteria outlined in the relevant Articles and the inclusion of new systems in: (a) the list set out in Annex III, including the extension of existing area headings or the addition of new area headings in that Annex; (b) the list of prohibited practices set out in Article 5; and (c) the list of AI systems requiring additional transparency measures pursuant to Article 50.

Any amendment to this Regulation pursuant to paragraph 10, or relevant delegated or implementing acts, which concerns sectoral Union harmonisation legislation listed in Section B of Annex I shall take into account the regulatory specificities of each sector, and the existing governance, conformity assessment and enforcement mechanisms and authorities established therein.

By 2 August 2031, the Commission shall carry out an assessment of the enforcement of this Regulation and shall report on it to the European Parliament, the Council and the European Economic and Social Committee, taking into account the first years of application of this Regulation. On the basis of the findings, that report shall, where appropriate, be accompanied by a proposal for amendment of this Regulation with regard to the structure of enforcement and the need for a Union agency to resolve any identified shortcomings.

title: Entry into force and application
text: This Regulation shall enter into force on the twentieth day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union. It shall apply from 2 August 2026. However: (a) Chapters I and II shall apply from 2 February 2025; (b) Chapter III Section 4, Chapter V, Chapter VII and Chapter XII and Article 78 shall apply from 2 August 2025, with the exception of Article 101; (c) Article 6(1) and the corresponding obligations in this Regulation shall apply from 2 August 2027. This Regulation shall be binding in its entirety and directly applicable in all Member States. Done at Brussels, 13 June 2024. For the European Parliament The President R. METSOLA For the Council The President M. MICHEL

title: High-risk AI systems referred to in Article 6(2)
text: High-risk AI systems pursuant to Article 6(2) are the AI systems listed in any of the following areas:
text_ko: 제6조(2)에 따른 고위험 인공지능시스템은 다음 각 영역 중 어느 하나에 열거된 인공지능시스템을 말한다.

text: Biometrics, in so far as their use is permitted under relevant Union or national law: (a) remote biometric identification systems. This shall not include AI systems intended to be used for biometric verification the sole purpose of which is to confirm that a specific natural person is the person he or she claims to be; (b) AI systems intended to be used for biometric categorisation, according to sensitive or protected attributes or characteristics based on the inference of those attributes or characteristics; (c) AI systems intended to be used for emotion recognition.
text_ko: 생체정보, 관련 연합법 또는 국내법에 따라 그 사용이 허용되는 범위에서: (a) 원격생체식별시스템. 이는 특정 자연인이 본인이 주장하는 그 사람인지를 확인하는 것만을 유일한 목적으로 하는 생체검증에 사용되도록 의도된 인공지능시스템은 포함하지 아니한다; (b) 민감하거나 보호되는 속성이나 특성의 추론에 기초하여 생체분류를 하도록 의도된 인공지능시스템; (c) 감정인식에 사용되도록 의도된 인공지능시스템.

text: Critical infrastructure: AI systems intended to be used as safety components in the management and operation of critical digital infrastructure, road traffic, or in the supply of water, gas, heating or electricity.
text_ko: 핵심 인프라: 핵심 디지털 인프라, 도로교통, 또는 물·가스·난방·전기 공급의 관리와 운영에서 안전구성요소로 사용되도록 의도된 인공지능시스템.

text: Education and vocational training: (a) AI systems intended to be used to determine access or admission or to assign natural persons to educational and vocational training institutions at all levels; (b) AI systems intended to be used to evaluate learning outcomes, including when those outcomes are used to steer the learning process of natural persons in educational and vocational training institutions at all levels; (c) AI systems intended to be used for the purpose of assessing the appropriate level of education that an individual will receive or will be able to access, in the context of or within educational and vocational training institutions at all levels; (d) AI systems intended to be used for monitoring and detecting prohibited behaviour of students during tests in the context of or within educational and vocational training institutions at all levels.
text_ko: 교육 및 직업훈련: (a) 모든 수준의 교육 및 직업훈련 기관에 대한 자연인의 접근·입학 결정이나 배정에 사용되도록 의도된 인공지능시스템; (b) 학습성과를 평가하는 데 사용되도록 의도된 인공지능시스템(그 성과가 모든 수준의 교육·직업훈련 기관에서 자연인의 학습과정을 유도하는 데 사용되는 경우 포함); (c) 모든 수준의 교육·직업훈련 기관의 맥락에서 또는 그 내에서, 개인이 받게 될 또는 접근할 수 있게 될 적절한 교육 수준을 평가할 목적으로 사용되도록 의도된 인공지능시스템; (d) 모든 수준의 교육·직업훈련 기관의 맥락에서 또는 그 내에서, 시험 중 학생의 금지된 행동을 모니터링·탐지하는 데 사용되도록 의도된 인공지능시스템.

text: Employment, workers’ management and access to self-employment: (a) AI systems intended to be used for the recruitment or selection of natural persons, in particular to place targeted job advertisements, to analyse and filter job applications, and to evaluate candidates; (b) AI systems intended to be used to make decisions affecting terms of work-related relationships, the promotion or termination of work-related contractual relationships, to allocate tasks based on individual behaviour or personal traits or characteristics or to monitor and evaluate the performance and behaviour of persons in such relationships.
text_ko: 고용, 근로자 관리 및 자영업 접근: (a) 자연인의 채용이나 선발에 사용되도록 의도된 인공지능시스템, 특히 표적화된 구인광고를 게재하고, 구직신청을 분석·필터링하며, 후보자를 평가하기 위한 것; (b) 근로관계 조건에 영향을 미치는 결정, 근로계약관계의 승진이나 종료, 개인의 행동이나 인격 특성에 기초한 과업 배정, 또는 그러한 관계 내 사람의 성과와 행동을 모니터링·평가하는 데 사용되도록 의도된 인공지능시스템.

text: Access to and enjoyment of essential private services and essential public services and benefits: (a) AI systems intended to be used by public authorities or on behalf of public authorities to evaluate the eligibility of natural persons for essential public assistance benefits and services, including healthcare services, as well as to grant, reduce, revoke, or reclaim such benefits and services; (b) AI systems intended to be used to evaluate the creditworthiness of natural persons or establish their credit score, with the exception of AI systems used for the purpose of detecting financial fraud; (c) AI systems intended to be used for risk assessment and pricing in relation to natural persons in the case of life and health insurance; (d) AI systems intended to evaluate and classify emergency calls by natural persons or to be used to dispatch, or to establish priority in the dispatching of, emergency first response services, including by police, firefighters and medical aid, as well as of emergency healthcare patient triage systems.
text_ko: 필수 민간서비스·필수 공공서비스 및 혜택에 대한 접근과 향유: (a) 공공당국이 또는 공공당국을 대신하여, 의료서비스를 포함한 필수 공공지원 혜택·서비스에 대한 자연인의 자격을 평가하고, 그러한 혜택·서비스를 부여·축소·철회·환수하는 데 사용되도록 의도된 인공지능시스템; (b) 자연인의 신용도를 평가하거나 신용점수를 산정하는 데 사용되도록 의도된 인공지능시스템(금융사기 탐지 목적으로 사용되는 인공지능시스템은 제외); (c) 생명·건강보험과 관련하여 자연인에 대한 위험평가 및 가격산정에 사용되도록 의도된 인공지능시스템; (d) 자연인의 응급전화를 평가·분류하거나, 경찰·소방관·의료지원을 포함한 응급 초동대응서비스의 파견 또는 파견 우선순위 결정에 사용되도록 의도된 인공지능시스템(응급의료환자 중증도분류시스템 포함).

text: Law enforcement, in so far as their use is permitted under relevant Union or national law: (a) AI systems intended to be used by or on behalf of law enforcement authorities, or by Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies in support of law enforcement authorities or on their behalf to assess the risk of a natural person becoming the victim of criminal offences; (b) AI systems intended to be used by or on behalf of law enforcement authorities or by Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies in support of law enforcement authorities as polygraphs or similar tools; (c) AI systems intended to be used by or on behalf of law enforcement authorities, or by Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies, in support of law enforcement authorities to evaluate the reliability of evidence in the course of the investigation or prosecution of criminal offences; (d) AI systems intended to be used by law enforcement authorities or on their behalf or by Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies in support of law enforcement authorities for assessing the risk of a natural person offending or re-offending not solely on the basis of the profiling of natural persons as referred to in Article 3(4) of Directive (EU) 2016/680, or to assess personality traits and characteristics or past criminal behaviour of natural persons or groups; (e) AI systems intended to be used by or on behalf of law enforcement authorities or by Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies in support of law enforcement authorities for the profiling of natural persons as referred to in Article 3(4) of Directive (EU) 2016/680 in the course of the detection, investigation or prosecution of criminal offences.
text_ko: 법집행, 관련 연합법 또는 국내법에 따라 그 사용이 허용되는 범위에서: (a) 법집행당국이 또는 법집행당국을 대신하여, 또는 법집행당국을 지원하는 연합 기관·기구·사무소·청이 또는 이들을 대신하여, 자연인이 범죄피해자가 될 위험을 평가하는 데 사용되도록 의도된 인공지능시스템; (b) 법집행당국이 또는 법집행당국을 대신하여, 또는 법집행당국을 지원하는 연합 기관·기구·사무소·청이 거짓말탐지기 또는 이와 유사한 도구로 사용되도록 의도된 인공지능시스템; (c) 법집행당국이 또는 법집행당국을 대신하여, 또는 법집행당국을 지원하는 연합 기관·기구·사무소·청이, 범죄의 수사 또는 기소 과정에서 증거의 신뢰성을 평가하는 데 사용되도록 의도된 인공지능시스템; (d) 법집행당국이 또는 법집행당국을 대신하여, 또는 법집행당국을 지원하는 연합 기관·기구·사무소·청이, 지침(EU) 2016/680 제3조(4)에서 정하는 자연인에 대한 프로파일링만에 근거하지 아니하고 자연인이 범죄를 저지르거나 재범할 위험을 평가하거나, 자연인 또는 집단의 인격 특성·과거 범죄행위를 평가하는 데 사용되도록 의도된 인공지능시스템; (e) 법집행당국이 또는 법집행당국을 대신하여, 또는 법집행당국을 지원하는 연합 기관·기구·사무소·청이, 범죄의 탐지·수사·기소 과정에서 지침(EU) 2016/680 제3조(4)에서 정하는 자연인에 대한 프로파일링에 사용되도록 의도된 인공지능시스템.

text: Migration, asylum and border control management, in so far as their use is permitted under relevant Union or national law: (a) AI systems intended to be used by or on behalf of competent public authorities or by Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies as polygraphs or similar tools; (b) AI systems intended to be used by or on behalf of competent public authorities or by Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies to assess a risk, including a security risk, a risk of irregular migration, or a health risk, posed by a natural person who intends to enter or who has entered into the territory of a Member State; (c) AI systems intended to be used by or on behalf of competent public authorities or by Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies to assist competent public authorities for the examination of applications for asylum, visa or residence permits and for associated complaints with regard to the eligibility of the natural persons applying for a status, including related assessments of the reliability of evidence; (d) AI systems intended to be used by or on behalf of competent public authorities, or by Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies, in the context of migration, asylum or border control management, for the purpose of detecting, recognising or identifying natural persons, with the exception of the verification of travel documents.
text_ko: 이주, 망명 및 국경관리, 관련 연합법 또는 국내법에 따라 그 사용이 허용되는 범위에서: (a) 관할 공공당국이 또는 이를 대신하여, 또는 연합 기관·기구·사무소·청이 거짓말탐지기 또는 이와 유사한 도구로 사용되도록 의도된 인공지능시스템; (b) 관할 공공당국이 또는 이를 대신하여, 또는 연합 기관·기구·사무소·청이, 회원국 영토에 입국하려 하거나 입국한 자연인이 제기하는 위험(안보위험, 불법이주위험 또는 건강위험 포함)을 평가하는 데 사용되도록 의도된 인공지능시스템; (c) 관할 공공당국이 또는 이를 대신하여, 또는 연합 기관·기구·사무소·청이, 망명·비자·거주허가 신청 및 관련 이의제기의 심사에서 지위신청 자연인의 자격에 관하여 관할 공공당국을 지원하는 데 사용되도록 의도된 인공지능시스템(증거의 신뢰성에 관한 관련 평가 포함); (d) 관할 공공당국이 또는 이를 대신하여, 또는 연합 기관·기구·사무소·청이, 이주·망명·국경관리의 맥락에서 자연인을 탐지·인식·식별할 목적으로 사용되도록 의도된 인공지능시스템(여행문서의 검증은 제외).

text: Administration of justice and democratic processes: (a) AI systems intended to be used by a judicial authority or on their behalf to assist a judicial authority in researching and interpreting facts and the law and in applying the law to a concrete set of facts, or to be used in a similar way in alternative dispute resolution; (b) AI systems intended to be used for influencing the outcome of an election or referendum or the voting behaviour of natural persons in the exercise of their vote in elections or referenda. This does not include AI systems to the output of which natural persons are not directly exposed, such as tools used to organise, optimise or structure political campaigns from an administrative or logistical point of view.
text_ko: 사법행정 및 민주적 절차: (a) 사법당국이 또는 이를 대신하여, 사실관계와 법률의 조사·해석 및 구체적 사실관계에 대한 법률 적용을 지원하기 위해 사용되도록 의도되거나, 대체적 분쟁해결에서 유사한 방식으로 사용되도록 의도된 인공지능시스템; (b) 선거나 국민투표의 결과 또는 자연인이 선거·국민투표에서 투표권을 행사함에 있어서의 투표행태에 영향을 미치는 데 사용되도록 의도된 인공지능시스템(다만 행정적·물류적 관점에서 정치캠페인을 조직·최적화·구조화하는 데 사용되는 도구 등, 자연인이 그 산출물에 직접 노출되지 아니하는 인공지능시스템은 포함하지 아니한다).

title: Technical documentation referred to in Article 11(1)
text: The technical documentation referred to in Article 11(1) shall contain at least the following information, as applicable to the relevant AI system:
requirement_note: 하위 항에서 판정 — 상위는 중복이라 세지 않는다
text_ko: 제11조(1)에서 정하는 기술문서는, 해당 인공지능시스템에 적용 가능한 범위에서, 최소한 다음 정보를 포함하여야 한다.

text: A general description of the AI system including: (a) its intended purpose, the name of the provider and the version of the system reflecting its relation to previous versions; (b) how the AI system interacts with, or can be used to interact with, hardware or software, including with other AI systems, that are not part of the AI system itself, where applicable; (c) the versions of relevant software or firmware, and any requirements related to version updates; (d) the description of all the forms in which the AI system is placed on the market or put into service, such as software packages embedded into hardware, downloads, or APIs; (e) the description of the hardware on which the AI system is intended to run; (f) where the AI system is a component of products, photographs or illustrations showing external features, the marking and internal layout of those products; (g) a basic description of the user-interface provided to the deployer; (h) instructions for use for the deployer, and a basic description of the user-interface provided to the deployer, where applicable;
text_ko: 다음을 포함한 인공지능시스템에 대한 일반적 설명: (a) 그 의도된 목적, 제공자의 명칭 및 이전 버전과의 관계를 반영한 시스템의 버전; (b) 인공지능시스템 자체의 일부가 아닌 하드웨어나 소프트웨어(다른 인공지능시스템을 포함)와 상호작용하는 방식 또는 상호작용에 사용될 수 있는 방식(해당하는 경우); (c) 관련 소프트웨어나 펌웨어의 버전, 그리고 버전 업데이트와 관련된 요건; (d) 하드웨어에 내장된 소프트웨어 패키지, 다운로드 또는 API 등 인공지능시스템이 시장에 출시되거나 서비스가 제공되는 모든 형태에 대한 설명; (e) 인공지능시스템이 작동하도록 의도된 하드웨어에 대한 설명; (f) 인공지능시스템이 제품의 구성요소인 경우, 그 제품의 외부 특징, 마킹 및 내부 배치를 보여주는 사진 또는 그림; (g) 배포자에게 제공되는 사용자 인터페이스에 대한 기본 설명; (h) 배포자를 위한 사용설명서 및, 해당하는 경우, 배포자에게 제공되는 사용자 인터페이스에 대한 기본 설명;

text: A detailed description of the elements of the AI system and of the process for its development, including: (a) the methods and steps performed for the development of the AI system, including, where relevant, recourse to pre-trained systems or tools provided by third parties and how those were used, integrated or modified by the provider; (b) the design specifications of the system, namely the general logic of the AI system and of the algorithms; the key design choices including the rationale and assumptions made, including with regard to persons or groups of persons in respect of who, the system is intended to be used; the main classification choices; what the system is designed to optimise for, and the relevance of the different parameters; the description of the expected output and output quality of the system; the decisions about any possible trade-off made regarding the technical solutions adopted to comply with the requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2; (c) the description of the system architecture explaining how software components build on or feed into each other and integrate into the overall processing; the computational resources used to develop, train, test and validate the AI system; (d) where relevant, the data requirements in terms of datasheets describing the training methodologies and techniques and the training data sets used, including a general description of these data sets, information about their provenance, scope and main characteristics; how the data was obtained and selected; labelling procedures (e.g. for supervised learning), data cleaning methodologies (e.g. outliers detection); (e) assessment of the human oversight measures needed in accordance with Article 14, including an assessment of the technical measures needed to facilitate the interpretation of the outputs of AI systems by the deployers, in accordance with Article 13(3), point (d); (f) where applicable, a detailed description of pre-determined changes to the AI system and its performance, together with all the relevant information related to the technical solutions adopted to ensure continuous compliance of the AI system with the relevant requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2; (g) the validation and testing procedures used, including information about the validation and testing data used and their main characteristics; metrics used to measure accuracy, robustness and compliance with other relevant requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2, as well as potentially discriminatory impacts; test logs and all test reports dated and signed by the responsible persons, including with regard to pre-determined changes as referred to under point (f); (h) cybersecurity measures put in place;
text_ko: 다음을 포함한, 인공지능시스템의 요소 및 그 개발과정에 대한 상세한 설명: (a) 인공지능시스템 개발을 위해 수행된 방법과 절차(관련되는 경우, 제3자가 제공한 사전훈련된 시스템이나 도구의 사용 및 제공자가 이를 사용, 통합 또는 수정한 방식을 포함); (b) 시스템의 설계사양, 즉 인공지능시스템 및 알고리즘의 일반적 논리; 그 근거와 가정을 포함한 주요 설계상의 선택(시스템이 사용되고자 하는 대상이 되는 개인 또는 집단에 관한 사항을 포함); 주요 분류 선택; 시스템이 최적화하도록 설계된 대상 및 여러 파라미터의 관련성; 시스템의 예상 산출물 및 산출물 품질에 대한 설명; 제III장 제2절에서 정하는 요건을 준수하기 위해 채택된 기술적 해결책에 관하여 이루어진 발생 가능한 절충에 대한 결정; (c) 소프트웨어 구성요소가 서로 어떻게 구축되거나 연계되어 전체 처리과정에 통합되는지를 설명하는 시스템 구조에 대한 설명; 인공지능시스템의 개발, 훈련, 시험 및 검증에 사용된 연산자원; (d) 관련되는 경우, 훈련방법론과 기법 및 사용된 훈련 데이터 세트를 설명하는 데이터시트 형태의 데이터 요건(그 데이터 세트에 대한 일반적 설명, 출처, 범위 및 주요 특성에 관한 정보를 포함); 데이터가 획득되고 선정된 방식; 라벨링 절차(예: 지도학습의 경우); 데이터 정제 방법론(예: 이상치 탐지); (e) 제13조(3) (d)호에 따라 배포자에 의한 인공지능시스템 산출물의 해석을 촉진하는 데 필요한 기술적 조치에 대한 평가를 포함하여, 제14조에 따라 필요한 인적 감독조치에 대한 평가; (f) 해당하는 경우, 인공지능시스템 및 그 성능에 대해 미리 정해진 변경사항에 대한 상세한 설명과, 제III장 제2절에서 정하는 관련 요건에 대한 인공지능시스템의 지속적 준수를 보장하기 위해 채택된 기술적 해결책과 관련된 모든 관련 정보; (g) 사용된 검증 및 시험 절차(사용된 검증·시험 데이터에 관한 정보 및 그 주요 특성을 포함); 정확성, 견고성 및 제III장 제2절에서 정하는 그 밖의 관련 요건에 대한 준수, 그리고 잠재적으로 차별적인 영향을 측정하기 위해 사용된 지표; (f)호에서 정하는 미리 정해진 변경사항에 관한 사항을 포함하여, 책임자가 서명하고 날짜가 기재된 시험 로그 및 모든 시험 보고서; (h) 마련된 사이버보안조치;

text: Detailed information about the monitoring, functioning and control of the AI system, in particular with regard to: its capabilities and limitations in performance, including the degrees of accuracy for specific persons or groups of persons on which the system is intended to be used and the overall expected level of accuracy in relation to its intended purpose; the foreseeable unintended outcomes and sources of risks to health and safety, fundamental rights and discrimination in view of the intended purpose of the AI system; the human oversight measures needed in accordance with Article 14, including the technical measures put in place to facilitate the interpretation of the outputs of AI systems by the deployers; specifications on input data, as appropriate;
text_ko: 인공지능시스템의 모니터링, 기능 및 통제에 관한 상세한 정보로서, 특히 다음에 관한 것: 시스템이 사용되고자 하는 대상이 되는 특정 개인이나 집단에 대한 정확성의 정도 및 그 의도된 목적과 관련하여 기대되는 전반적인 정확성 수준을 포함한 성능상의 역량과 한계; 인공지능시스템의 의도된 목적에 비추어 예견 가능한 의도되지 아니한 결과 및 건강·안전·기본권·차별에 대한 위험의 원천; 배포자에 의한 인공지능시스템 산출물의 해석을 촉진하기 위해 마련된 기술적 조치를 포함하여, 제14조에 따라 필요한 인적 감독조치; 적절한 경우 입력데이터에 관한 사양;

text: A description of the appropriateness of the performance metrics for the specific AI system;
text_ko: 해당 특정 인공지능시스템에 대한 성능지표의 적절성에 대한 설명;

text: A detailed description of the risk management system in accordance with Article 9;
text_ko: 제9조에 따른 위험관리시스템에 대한 상세한 설명;

text: A description of relevant changes made by the provider to the system through its lifecycle;
text_ko: 제공자가 시스템의 수명주기 동안 그 시스템에 가한 관련 변경사항에 대한 설명;

text: A list of the harmonised standards applied in full or in part the references of which have been published in the Official Journal of the European Union; where no such harmonised standards have been applied, a detailed description of the solutions adopted to meet the requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2, including a list of other relevant standards and technical specifications applied;
text_ko: 전체 또는 일부가 적용되었고 그 참조번호가 유럽연합관보에 공표된 조화표준 목록; 그러한 조화표준이 적용되지 아니한 경우, 제III장 제2절에서 정하는 요건을 충족하기 위해 채택된 해결책(적용된 그 밖의 관련 표준 및 기술사양의 목록을 포함)에 대한 상세한 설명;

text: A copy of the EU declaration of conformity referred to in Article 47;
text_ko: 제47조에서 정하는 EU 적합성 선언서의 사본;

text: A detailed description of the system in place to evaluate the AI system performance in the post-market phase in accordance with Article 72, including the post-market monitoring plan referred to in Article 72(3).
ai_bom_note: 72조(3)과 같은 계획 — 기술문서 항목이지만 내용이 앞으로 할 일이다
text_ko: 제72조(3)에서 정하는 시판 후 모니터링 계획을 포함하여, 제72조에 따라 시판 후 단계에서 인공지능시스템의 성능을 평가하기 위해 마련된 체계에 대한 상세한 설명.

title: EU declaration of conformity
text: The EU declaration of conformity referred to in Article 47, shall contain all of the following information:
requirement_note: 하위 항에서 판정 — 상위는 중복이라 세지 않는다
text_ko: 제47조에서 정하는 EU 적합성 선언서는 다음 정보를 모두 포함하여야 한다.

text: AI system name and type and any additional unambiguous reference allowing the identification and traceability of the AI system;
text_ko: 인공지능시스템의 명칭과 유형, 그리고 인공지능시스템의 식별과 추적을 가능하게 하는 그 밖의 명확한 참조사항;

text: The name and address of the provider or, where applicable, of their authorised representative;
text_ko: 제공자 또는, 해당하는 경우, 그 수권대리인의 명칭과 주소;

text: A statement that the EU declaration of conformity referred to in Article 47 is issued under the sole responsibility of the provider;
text_ko: 제47조에서 정하는 EU 적합성 선언서가 제공자의 단독 책임 하에 발급된다는 진술;

text: A statement that the AI system is in conformity with this Regulation and, if applicable, with any other relevant Union law that provides for the issuing of the EU declaration of conformity referred to in Article 47;
text_ko: 인공지능시스템이 이 규정 및, 해당하는 경우, 제47조에서 정하는 EU 적합성 선언서의 발급을 규정하는 그 밖의 관련 연합법을 준수한다는 진술;

text: Where an AI system involves the processing of personal data, a statement that that AI system complies with Regulations (EU) 2016/679 and (EU) 2018/1725 and Directive (EU) 2016/680;
text_ko: 인공지능시스템이 개인데이터의 처리를 수반하는 경우, 그 인공지능시스템이 규정(EU) 2016/679 및 규정(EU) 2018/1725, 지침(EU) 2016/680을 준수한다는 진술;

text: References to any relevant harmonised standards used or any other common specification in relation to which conformity is declared;
text_ko: 적용된 관련 조화표준 또는 그 밖의 공통기술규격으로서 적합성이 선언되는 대상에 대한 참조;

text: Where applicable, the name and identification number of the notified body, a description of the conformity assessment procedure performed, and identification of the certificate issued;
text_ko: 해당하는 경우, 인증기관의 명칭과 식별번호, 수행된 적합성평가절차에 대한 설명, 그리고 발급된 인증서의 식별;

text: The place and date of issue of the declaration, the name and function of the person who signed it, as well as an indication for, or on behalf of whom, that person signed, a signature.
ai_bom_note: 컴포넌트가 아니라 선언서라는 문서 자체의 발급 정보다
text_ko: 선언서의 발급 장소와 일자, 서명한 자의 성명과 직위, 그리고 누구를 위하여 또는 누구를 대신하여 서명하였는지에 대한 표시, 서명.

title: Conformity assessment procedure based on internal control

text: The conformity assessment procedure based on internal control is the conformity assessment procedure based on points 2, 3 and 4.
text_ko: 내부통제 기반 적합성평가절차는 제2호, 제3호 및 제4호를 기초로 하는 적합성평가절차이다.

text: The provider verifies that the established quality management system is in compliance with the requirements of Article 17.
text_ko: 제공자는 수립된 품질관리시스템이 제17조의 요건을 준수함을 확인한다.

text: The provider examines the information contained in the technical documentation in order to assess the compliance of the AI system with the relevant essential requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2.
text_ko: 제공자는 기술문서에 포함된 정보를 검토하여 인공지능시스템이 제III장 제2절에서 정하는 관련 필수요건을 준수하는지를 평가한다.

text: The provider also verifies that the design and development process of the AI system and its post-market monitoring as referred to in Article 72 is consistent with the technical documentation.
text_ko: 제공자는 또한 인공지능시스템의 설계·개발 과정 및 제72조에서 정하는 시판 후 모니터링이 기술문서와 일치하는지를 확인한다.

title: Conformity based on an assessment of the quality management system and an assessment of the technical documentation
title_ko: 품질관리시스템 평가 및 기술문서 평가에 기반한 적합성

text: Introduction Conformity based on an assessment of the quality management system and an assessment of the technical documentation is the conformity assessment procedure based on points 2 to 5.
text_ko: 도입 — 품질관리시스템 평가 및 기술문서 평가에 기반한 적합성은 제2호부터 제5호까지를 기초로 하는 적합성평가절차이다.

text: Overview The approved quality management system for the design, development and testing of AI systems pursuant to Article 17 shall be examined in accordance with point 3 and shall be subject to surveillance as specified in point 5. The technical documentation of the AI system shall be examined in accordance with point 4.
text_ko: 개요 — 제17조에 따른 인공지능시스템의 설계·개발·시험을 위해 승인된 품질관리시스템은 제3호에 따라 검토되고 제5호에서 정하는 감시의 대상이 된다. 인공지능시스템의 기술문서는 제4호에 따라 검토된다.

text: Quality management system
text_ko: 품질관리시스템

text: The application of the provider shall include: (a) the name and address of the provider and, if the application is lodged by an authorised representative, also their name and address; (b) the list of AI systems covered under the same quality management system; (c) the technical documentation for each AI system covered under the same quality management system; (d) the documentation concerning the quality management system which shall cover all the aspects listed under Article 17; (e) a description of the procedures in place to ensure that the quality management system remains adequate and effective; (f) a written declaration that the same application has not been lodged with any other notified body.
text_ko: 제공자의 신청서는 다음을 포함하여야 한다. (a) 제공자의 명칭과 주소, 그리고 수권대리인이 신청서를 제출하는 경우 그 명칭과 주소; (b) 동일한 품질관리시스템의 적용을 받는 인공지능시스템 목록; (c) 동일한 품질관리시스템의 적용을 받는 각 인공지능시스템의 기술문서; (d) 제17조에 열거된 모든 측면을 포괄하는 품질관리시스템에 관한 문서; (e) 품질관리시스템이 적절하고 효과적인 상태를 유지하도록 보장하는 절차에 대한 설명; (f) 동일한 신청서가 다른 인증기관에 제출되지 아니하였다는 서면 진술.

text: The quality management system shall be assessed by the notified body, which shall determine whether it satisfies the requirements referred to in Article 17. The decision shall be notified to the provider or its authorised representative. The notification shall contain the conclusions of the assessment of the quality management system and the reasoned assessment decision.
text_ko: 품질관리시스템은 인증기관에 의해 평가되며, 인증기관은 그것이 제17조에서 정하는 요건을 충족하는지를 판단한다. 그 결정은 제공자 또는 그 수권대리인에게 통지된다. 통지에는 품질관리시스템 평가의 결론과 사유를 명시한 평가결정이 포함되어야 한다.

text: The quality management system as approved shall continue to be implemented and maintained by the provider so that it remains adequate and efficient.
text_ko: 승인된 품질관리시스템은 그것이 적절하고 효율적인 상태를 유지하도록 제공자에 의해 계속 시행·유지되어야 한다.

text: Any intended change to the approved quality management system or the list of AI systems covered by the latter shall be brought to the attention of the notified body by the provider. The proposed changes shall be examined by the notified body, which shall decide whether the modified quality management system continues to satisfy the requirements referred to in point 3.2 or whether a reassessment is necessary. The notified body shall notify the provider of its decision. The notification shall contain the conclusions of the examination of the changes and the reasoned assessment decision.
text_ko: 승인된 품질관리시스템 또는 그 적용을 받는 인공지능시스템 목록에 대한 의도된 변경은 제공자가 인증기관에 알려야 한다. 제안된 변경은 인증기관이 검토하며, 인증기관은 변경된 품질관리시스템이 제3.2점에서 정하는 요건을 계속 충족하는지, 또는 재평가가 필요한지를 결정한다. 인증기관은 그 결정을 제공자에게 통지한다. 통지에는 변경 검토의 결론과 사유를 명시한 평가결정이 포함되어야 한다.

text: Control of the technical documentation.
text_ko: 기술문서의 통제

text: In addition to the application referred to in point 3, an application with a notified body of their choice shall be lodged by the provider for the assessment of the technical documentation relating to the AI system which the provider intends to place on the market or put into service and which is covered by the quality management system referred to under point 3.
text_ko: 제3호에서 정하는 신청서에 더하여, 제공자는 자신이 시장에 출시하거나 서비스를 제공하고자 하고 제3호에서 정하는 품질관리시스템의 적용을 받는 인공지능시스템의 기술문서 평가를 위하여, 자신이 선택한 인증기관에 신청서를 제출하여야 한다.

text: The application shall include: (a) the name and address of the provider; (b) a written declaration that the same application has not been lodged with any other notified body; (c) the technical documentation referred to in Annex IV.
text_ko: 신청서는 다음을 포함하여야 한다. (a) 제공자의 명칭과 주소; (b) 동일한 신청서가 다른 인증기관에 제출되지 아니하였다는 서면 진술; (c) 부속서 IV에서 정하는 기술문서.

text: The technical documentation shall be examined by the notified body. Where relevant, and limited to what is necessary to fulfil its tasks, the notified body shall be granted full access to the training, validation, and testing data sets used, including, where appropriate and subject to security safeguards, through API or other relevant technical means and tools enabling remote access.
text_ko: 기술문서는 인증기관이 검토한다. 관련되는 경우, 그리고 그 임무 수행에 필요한 범위로 한정하여, 인증기관은 사용된 훈련·검증·시험 데이터 세트에 대한 완전한 접근권을 부여받아야 하며, 적절하고 보안상 안전조치를 조건으로 API나 그 밖의 관련 기술적 수단·도구를 통한 원격접근도 포함한다.

text: In examining the technical documentation, the notified body may require that the provider supply further evidence or carry out further tests so as to enable a proper assessment of the conformity of the AI system with the requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2. Where the notified body is not satisfied with the tests carried out by the provider, the notified body shall itself directly carry out adequate tests, as appropriate.
text_ko: 기술문서를 검토함에 있어, 인증기관은 제III장 제2절에서 정하는 요건에 대한 인공지능시스템의 적합성을 적절히 평가할 수 있도록 제공자에게 추가 증거의 제공이나 추가 시험의 수행을 요구할 수 있다. 인증기관이 제공자가 수행한 시험에 만족하지 아니하는 경우, 인증기관은 적절한 경우 스스로 직접 적절한 시험을 수행한다.

text: Where necessary to assess the conformity of the high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2, after all other reasonable means to verify conformity have been exhausted and have proven to be insufficient, and upon a reasoned request, the notified body shall also be granted access to the training and trained models of the AI system, including its relevant parameters. Such access shall be subject to existing Union law on the protection of intellectual property and trade secrets.
text_ko: 제III장 제2절에서 정하는 요건에 대한 고위험 인공지능시스템의 적합성을 평가하기 위하여 필요한 경우, 적합성을 검증할 그 밖의 모든 합리적인 수단이 소진되었고 불충분한 것으로 판명된 후, 그리고 사유를 소명한 요청에 따라, 인증기관은 인공지능시스템의 훈련 및 훈련된 모델(그 관련 파라미터를 포함)에 대한 접근권도 부여받는다. 그러한 접근은 지식재산권 및 영업비밀 보호에 관한 기존 연합법의 적용을 받는다.

text: The decision of the notified body shall be notified to the provider or its authorised representative. The notification shall contain the conclusions of the assessment of the technical documentation and the reasoned assessment decision. Where the AI system is in conformity with the requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2, the notified body shall issue a Union technical documentation assessment certificate. The certificate shall indicate the name and address of the provider, the conclusions of the examination, the conditions (if any) for its validity and the data necessary for the identification of the AI system. The certificate and its annexes shall contain all relevant information to allow the conformity of the AI system to be evaluated, and to allow for control of the AI system while in use, where applicable. Where the AI system is not in conformity with the requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2, the notified body shall refuse to issue a Union technical documentation assessment certificate and shall inform the applicant accordingly, giving detailed reasons for its refusal. Where the AI system does not meet the requirement relating to the data used to train it, re-training of the AI system will be needed prior to the application for a new conformity assessment. In this case, the reasoned assessment decision of the notified body refusing to issue the Union technical documentation assessment certificate shall contain specific considerations on the quality data used to train the AI system, in particular on the reasons for non-compliance.
text_ko: 인증기관의 결정은 제공자 또는 그 수권대리인에게 통지된다. 통지에는 기술문서 평가의 결론과 사유를 명시한 평가결정이 포함되어야 한다. 인공지능시스템이 제III장 제2절에서 정하는 요건을 준수하는 경우, 인증기관은 연합 기술문서평가 인증서를 발급한다. 인증서에는 제공자의 명칭과 주소, 검토의 결론, (있는 경우) 그 유효조건, 그리고 인공지능시스템의 식별에 필요한 데이터가 표시되어야 한다. 인증서와 그 부속서에는 인공지능시스템의 적합성을 평가하고, 해당하는 경우 사용 중 인공지능시스템을 통제할 수 있도록 하는 모든 관련 정보가 포함되어야 한다. 인공지능시스템이 제III장 제2절에서 정하는 요건을 준수하지 아니하는 경우, 인증기관은 연합 기술문서평가 인증서의 발급을 거부하고 상세한 거부사유를 제시하여 신청인에게 통지한다. 인공지능시스템이 그것을 훈련시키는 데 사용된 데이터에 관한 요건을 충족하지 못하는 경우, 새로운 적합성평가를 신청하기 전에 인공지능시스템의 재훈련이 필요하다. 이 경우, 연합 기술문서평가 인증서 발급을 거부하는 인증기관의 사유를 소명한 평가결정에는 인공지능시스템을 훈련시키는 데 사용된 데이터의 품질에 관한 구체적인 고려사항(특히 부적합 사유)이 포함되어야 한다.

text: Any change to the AI system that could affect the compliance of the AI system with the requirements or its intended purpose shall be assessed by the notified body which issued the Union technical documentation assessment certificate. The provider shall inform such notified body of its intention to introduce any of the abovementioned changes, or if it otherwise becomes aware of the occurrence of such changes. The intended changes shall be assessed by the notified body, which shall decide whether those changes require a new conformity assessment in accordance with Article 43(4) or whether they could be addressed by means of a supplement to the Union technical documentation assessment certificate. In the latter case, the notified body shall assess the changes, notify the provider of its decision and, where the changes are approved, issue to the provider a supplement to the Union technical documentation assessment certificate.
text_ko: 인공지능시스템의 요건 준수나 의도된 목적에 영향을 미칠 수 있는 인공지능시스템에 대한 변경은 연합 기술문서평가 인증서를 발급한 인증기관이 평가하여야 한다. 제공자는 그러한 변경을 도입하려는 의도를, 또는 그렇지 아니하면 그러한 변경의 발생을 인지하게 된 경우 이를, 해당 인증기관에 알려야 한다. 의도된 변경은 인증기관이 평가하며, 인증기관은 그러한 변경이 제43조(4)에 따른 새로운 적합성평가를 필요로 하는지, 또는 연합 기술문서평가 인증서의 보충서로 처리될 수 있는지를 결정한다. 후자의 경우, 인증기관은 변경사항을 평가하고 그 결정을 제공자에게 통지하며, 변경사항이 승인되는 경우 제공자에게 연합 기술문서평가 인증서의 보충서를 발급한다.

text: Surveillance of the approved quality management system.
text_ko: 승인된 품질관리시스템의 감시

text: The purpose of the surveillance carried out by the notified body referred to in Point 3 is to make sure that the provider duly complies with the terms and conditions of the approved quality management system.
text_ko: 제3호에서 정하는 인증기관이 수행하는 감시의 목적은 제공자가 승인된 품질관리시스템의 조건을 충실히 준수하는지를 확인하는 것이다.

text: For assessment purposes, the provider shall allow the notified body to access the premises where the design, development, testing of the AI systems is taking place. The provider shall further share with the notified body all necessary information.
text_ko: 평가 목적상, 제공자는 인공지능시스템의 설계·개발·시험이 이루어지는 시설에 인증기관이 접근할 수 있도록 하여야 한다. 제공자는 또한 필요한 모든 정보를 인증기관과 공유하여야 한다.

text: The notified body shall carry out periodic audits to make sure that the provider maintains and applies the quality management system and shall provide the provider with an audit report. In the context of those audits, the notified body may carry out additional tests of the AI systems for which a Union technical documentation assessment certificate was issued.
text_ko: 인증기관은 제공자가 품질관리시스템을 유지·적용하는지를 확인하기 위하여 정기적으로 심사를 수행하며, 제공자에게 심사보고서를 제공하여야 한다. 그러한 심사의 맥락에서, 인증기관은 연합 기술문서평가 인증서가 발급된 인공지능시스템에 대한 추가 시험을 수행할 수 있다.

title: Information to be submitted upon the registration of high-risk AI systems in accordance with Article 49
title_ko: 제49조에 따른 고위험 인공지능시스템 등록 시 제출할 정보

title: Information to be submitted by providers of high-risk AI systems in accordance with Article 49(1)
text: The following information shall be provided and thereafter kept up to date with regard to high-risk AI systems to be registered in accordance with Article 49(1):
requirement_note: 하위 항에서 판정 — 상위는 중복이라 세지 않는다
title_ko: 제49조(1)에 따라 등록되는 고위험 인공지능시스템의 제공자가 제출할 정보
text_ko: 제49조(1)에 따라 등록되는 고위험 인공지능시스템과 관련하여, 다음 정보가 제공되어야 하며 그 후 최신 상태로 유지되어야 한다.

text: The name, address and contact details of the provider;
text_ko: 제공자의 명칭, 주소 및 연락처;

text: Where submission of information is carried out by another person on behalf of the provider, the name, address and contact details of that person;
text_ko: 정보 제출이 제공자를 대신하여 다른 자에 의해 이루어지는 경우, 그 자의 명칭, 주소 및 연락처;

text: The name, address and contact details of the authorised representative, where applicable;
text_ko: 해당하는 경우, 수권대리인의 명칭, 주소 및 연락처;

text: The AI system trade name and any additional unambiguous reference allowing the identification and traceability of the AI system;
text_ko: 인공지능시스템의 거래명칭, 그리고 인공지능시스템의 식별과 추적을 가능하게 하는 그 밖의 명확한 참조사항;

text: A description of the intended purpose of the AI system and of the components and functions supported through this AI system;
text_ko: 인공지능시스템의 의도된 목적, 그리고 그 인공지능시스템을 통해 지원되는 구성요소와 기능에 대한 설명;

text: A basic and concise description of the information used by the system (data, inputs) and its operating logic;
text_ko: 시스템이 사용하는 정보(데이터, 입력값) 및 그 작동 논리에 대한 기본적이고 간결한 설명;

text: The status of the AI system (on the market, or in service; no longer placed on the market/in service, recalled);
text_ko: 인공지능시스템의 상태(시장 출시 또는 서비스 제공 중; 더 이상 시장에 출시되지 아니하거나 서비스가 제공되지 아니함/회수됨);

text: The type, number and expiry date of the certificate issued by the notified body and the name or identification number of that notified body, where applicable;
text_ko: 해당하는 경우, 인증기관이 발급한 인증서의 유형·번호·만료일, 그리고 그 인증기관의 명칭 또는 식별번호;

text: A scanned copy of the certificate referred to in point 8, where applicable;
text_ko: 해당하는 경우, 제8호에서 정하는 인증서의 스캔 사본;

text: Any Member States in which the AI system has been placed on the market, put into service or made available in the Union;
text_ko: 인공지능시스템이 연합 내에서 시장에 출시, 서비스 제공 또는 이용 가능하게 된 회원국;

text: A copy of the EU declaration of conformity referred to in Article 47;
text_ko: 제47조에서 정하는 EU 적합성 선언서의 사본;

text: Electronic instructions for use; this information shall not be provided for high-risk AI systems in the areas of law enforcement or migration, asylum and border control management referred to in Annex III, points 1, 6 and 7;
text_ko: 전자 사용설명서. 이 정보는 부속서 III 제1호·제6호·제7호에서 정하는 법집행 또는 이주·망명·국경관리 영역의 고위험 인공지능시스템에 대해서는 제공되지 아니한다;

text: A URL for additional information (optional).
text_ko: 추가 정보를 위한 URL(선택사항).

title: Information to be submitted by providers of high-risk AI systems in accordance with Article 49(2)
text: The following information shall be provided and thereafter kept up to date with regard to AI systems to be registered in accordance with Article 49(2):
requirement_note: 하위 항에서 판정 — 상위는 중복이라 세지 않는다
title_ko: — 제49조(2)에 따라 등록되는 인공지능시스템의 제공자가 제출할 정보
text_ko: 제49조(2)에 따라 등록되는 인공지능시스템과 관련하여, 다음 정보가 제공되어야 하며 그 후 최신 상태로 유지되어야 한다.

text: The name, address and contact details of the provider;
text_ko: 제공자의 명칭, 주소 및 연락처;

text: Where submission of information is carried out by another person on behalf of the provider, the name, address and contact details of that person;
text_ko: 정보 제출이 제공자를 대신하여 다른 자에 의해 이루어지는 경우, 그 자의 명칭, 주소 및 연락처;

text: The name, address and contact details of the authorised representative, where applicable;
text_ko: 해당하는 경우, 수권대리인의 명칭, 주소 및 연락처;

text: The AI system trade name and any additional unambiguous reference allowing the identification and traceability of the AI system;
text_ko: 인공지능시스템의 거래명칭, 그리고 인공지능시스템의 식별과 추적을 가능하게 하는 그 밖의 명확한 참조사항;

text: A description of the intended purpose of the AI system;
text_ko: 인공지능시스템의 의도된 목적에 대한 설명;

text: The condition or conditions under Article 6(3)based on which the AI system is considered to be not-high-risk;
text_ko: 그 인공지능시스템이 고위험이 아니라고 간주되는 근거가 된, 제6조(3)에 따른 조건;

text: A short summary of the grounds on which the AI system is considered to be not-high-risk in application of the procedure under Article 6(3);
text_ko: 제6조(3)에 따른 절차의 적용에 있어 그 인공지능시스템이 고위험이 아니라고 간주되는 근거에 대한 간략한 요약;

text: The status of the AI system (on the market, or in service; no longer placed on the market/in service, recalled);
text_ko: 인공지능시스템의 상태(시장 출시 또는 서비스 제공 중; 더 이상 시장에 출시되지 아니하거나 서비스가 제공되지 아니함/회수됨);

text: Any Member States in which the AI system has been placed on the market, put into service or made available in the Union.
text_ko: 인공지능시스템이 연합 내에서 시장에 출시, 서비스 제공 또는 이용 가능하게 된 회원국.

title: Information to be submitted by deployers of high-risk AI systems in accordance with Article 49(3)
text: The following information shall be provided and thereafter kept up to date with regard to high-risk AI systems to be registered in accordance with Article 49(3):
requirement_note: 하위 항에서 판정 — 상위는 중복이라 세지 않는다
title_ko: 제49조(3)에 따라 고위험 인공지능시스템의 배포자가 제출할 정보
text_ko: 제49조(3)에 따라 등록되는 고위험 인공지능시스템과 관련하여, 다음 정보가 제공되어야 하며 그 후 최신 상태로 유지되어야 한다.

text: The name, address and contact details of the deployer;
ai_bom_note: 컴포넌트가 아니라 그 등록 정보를 낸 주체다
text_ko: 배포자의 명칭, 주소 및 연락처;

text: The name, address and contact details of the person submitting information on behalf of the deployer;
ai_bom_note: §C(1)과 같은 자리 — 문서를 제출한 주체다
text_ko: 배포자를 대신하여 정보를 제출하는 자의 명칭, 주소 및 연락처;

text: The URL of the entry of the AI system in the EU database by its provider;
text_ko: 그 제공자가 EU 데이터베이스에 등록한 인공지능시스템 항목의 URL;

text: A summary of the findings of the fundamental rights impact assessment conducted in accordance with Article 27;
text_ko: 제27조에 따라 실시된 기본권영향평가 결과의 요약

text: A summary of the data protection impact assessment carried out in accordance with Article 35 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 or Article 27 of Directive (EU) 2016/680 as specified in Article 26(8) of this Regulation, where applicable.
text_ko: 해당되는 경우, 이 규정 제26조제8항에서 정하는 바에 따라 규정(EU) 2016/679 제35조 또는 지침(EU) 2016/680 제27조에 따라 실시된 개인정보 영향평가의 요약

title: Information to be submitted upon the registration of high-risk AI systems listed in Annex III in relation to testing in real world conditions in accordance with Article 60
text: The following information shall be provided and thereafter kept up to date with regard to testing in real world conditions to be registered in accordance with Article 60:
requirement_note: 하위 항에서 판정 — 상위는 중복이라 세지 않는다
title_ko: 제60조에 따른 실세계 조건 시험 등록 시 제출할 정보
text_ko: 제60조에 따라 등록되는 실세계 조건 시험과 관련하여, 다음 정보가 제공되어야 하며 그 후 최신 상태로 유지되어야 한다.

text: A Union-wide unique single identification number of the testing in real world conditions;
ai_bom_note: 시험이라는 활동의 등록 정보다 — 시스템 자체의 설명은 IX(3)이 담는다
text_ko: 실세계 조건 시험의 연합 전역 단일식별번호;

text: The name and contact details of the provider or prospective provider and of the deployers involved in the testing in real world conditions;
ai_bom_note: IX(1)·(4)·(5)와 같은 자리 — 시험이라는 활동의 등록 정보다. 공급망·문서에 붙는 주체(§A(1)·§C(1)(2))는 담기지만 활동에 붙는 당사자는 그 축이 아니다
text_ko: 제공자 또는 장래 제공자 및 그 실세계 조건 시험에 관여하는 배포자의 명칭과 연락처;

text: A brief description of the AI system, its intended purpose, and other information necessary for the identification of the system;
ai_bom_note: 시험 등록정보 중 유일하게 시스템 자체의 설명이라 담는다
text_ko: 인공지능시스템에 대한 간략한 설명, 그 의도된 목적, 그리고 시스템의 식별에 필요한 그 밖의 정보;
